# authwise_guard_resources (Data Source)

A routed target in a Guard network that is not a node: a subnet, a host or an application. The nodes that serve it are managed by `authwise_guard_resource_nodes`. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String) The Guard tenant's id (`gt-…`), as awtenant reports it or `authwise_guard_tenants` lists it; the provider's `tenant_id` is not used.

### Optional

- `network_id` (String) Parent identifier `network_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `guard_resources` (Attributes List) Every resource under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guard_resources))

<a id="nestedatt--guard_resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guard_resources`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `guard_resource_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `kind` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `serving_node_ids` (List of String)
